g.text: Among seven recorded traits, nephrocalcinosis is the only one unsupported by both checks

text.style: fill: #5b6670; font: 11.5px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif

g.text: 3 traits are annotated in the MVA1 model; 1 more is supported by the series only through a broader growth phenotype; 2 cannot be judged (PARKED, not negative).

text.style: fill: #5b6670; font: 11.5px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif

g.text: Nephrocalcinosis is annotated in none of the three MVA models (best match 1.5 of 3.9 bits) and absent from the series, while 5 of 9 neighbour models cover it (3 Bartter).

text.style: fill: #5b6670; font: 11.5px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif

g.text: A residual trait raises, but does not establish, a second diagnosis.

text.style: fill: #5b6670; font: 6.7px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif

g.text: Sources: work/hpo/prepared.pkl (9 155 disease models) + work/hpo/phenotype.hpoa (names); check 2 and its percentages from docs/PHENOTYPE_RESIDUAL_AUDIT.md (EXP-018/019).

text.style: fill: #5b6670; font: 6.7px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif

g.text: Annotation bias is not corrected: a poorly annotated disease scores low even where the trait occurs. Columns are the nearest models to the FULL profile, not a search for renal models. Level L2.

text.style: fill: #5b6670; font: 6.2px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: end
